items.question: Which five principles beginning with ṭa are located in the right foot?
premises: The right foot is specified as the locus.
A group of five principles is assigned there.
These principles begin with the syllable ṭa.
items.inference: Therefore, the five principles beginning with ṭa are located in the right foot.
items.plain_english: O fair-faced one, the five principles beginning with ṭa are located in the right foot.
